The road breaks at Step 4. That step does not follow from the lines it cites, and it goes against the dated note on what may raise a level.

Step 4 quotes the note that need may count only to point toward the lower levels and rehabilitation, then uses biological necessity — what the node is, not its own act — as proof that those levels fail and that the rule must escalate to Level 4 against Level 5. Later steps are not reached.
